coverage.evidence: GoalHelpers.cs:17-64 registers exactly 14 keys: goal.followers.current/target/percent/remaining/bar (built by LiveGoalRows.cs:60-96), goal.followers.description (GoalHelpers.cs:26-31), the same five for subs (GoalHelpers.cs:39), goal.newSubs.current and goal.newSubs.percent only (GoalHelpers.cs:46-57), and goal.list (GoalHelpers.cs:64). Every row needs call.Args.Count == 0 (LiveGoalRows.cs:51, 107), so none takes arguments.

current/target/remaining use LiveText.Count, which calls StreamText.Grouped N0 with the channel culture (LiveText.cs:29-30, StreamText.cs:30). That culture is NumberCulture.For(Scope.Language), with en-US when the language is unset (LiveEventRow.cs:28, NumberCulture.cs:22-25). Remaining is Math.Max(0, target-current) (LiveText.cs:33). Percent is rounded to a whole number and not clamped (LiveText.cs:36-37, MusicText.cs:47-49). The bar has 10 marks, clamped to 0..100, followed by the percent (LiveText.cs:40-50, MeterBars.cs:17-26). The description is the Twitch goal Description, and an empty one gives null (GoalHelpers.cs:30). A null result renders as written, braces included (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46, 117-118). Examples recomputed: 1234/1500 gives 82%, 8 marks and 266. 80/100 gives 80%, 8 marks and 20. 6/20 gives 30%.

LiveEventRow.ToEntry uses TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (LiveEventRow.cs:44-51). Standard is every TemplateHelperContext except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22), and the enum holds Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook and Viewer (TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-62). This is the same six-context set as AllContexts in TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40.

GoalKind Followers matches type follower, Subs matches subscription and subscription_count, and NewSubs matches new_subscription and new_subscription_count, with list labels followers, subs and new subs (LiveGoalRows.cs:17-32). OfKindAsync takes the first matching goal in Twitch order (LiveGoalData.cs:53-54). goal.list goes through the goals in Twitch order and prints label plus percent, joined with ', ' (GoalHelpers.cs:67-79).

With no goal of the kind, OfKindAsync gives null and the row prints null (LiveGoalRows.cs:51-53, LiveGoalData.cs:53-54). A failed Twitch read gives an empty list (LiveGoalData.cs:63, including a missing scope at TwitchGoalsApi.cs:38-40). A null result renders as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46, 117-118). A target of 0 or less makes Percent and Bar null (LiveText.cs:36-48), so goal.list skips that goal and prints null when nothing is left (GoalHelpers.cs:73-79). Count and Remaining still print (LiveText.cs:29-33). One read is shared per render (LiveGoalData.cs:19-50).

reader_answers.evidence: The goal.<kind>.<part> forms and goal.list match GoalHelpers.cs:17-64 and LiveGoalRows.cs:60-96. No arguments is backed by Args.Count == 0 at LiveGoalRows.cs:51 and 107. The example reply's parts all exist for followers.
The helpers read only active creator goals from Helix 'goals' (TwitchGoalsApi.cs:46-54, LiveGoalData.cs:56-64). With none of the kind, the row prints null (LiveGoalRows.cs:51-53).

The sample values and per-part behavior match LiveText.cs:29-50, MeterBars.cs:17-26 and GoalHelpers.cs:24, 39 and 46-57. The claim that newSubs has only current and percent matches GoalHelpers.cs:43-58.

No active goal or a failed read gives null (LiveGoalRows.cs:51-53, LiveGoalData.cs:63). A null provider result is appended as '{' + content + '}' (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46, 117-118), so the helper shows as written.
